projects.name: TradeGuard
projects.description: Document Verification & Risk-Scoring Engine for Maritime Trade
highlights: Built TF-IDF classifier to categorize cargo documents (Bill of Lading, Invoice, Packing List) with regex extraction, ISO 6346 container check, and cross-document reconciliation for cargo weight and package validation.
Trained XGBoost risk model on 500 synthetic shipments achieving ROC-AUC 0.86 and 100% precision on auto-release.
Exposed via FastAPI with JWT auth, interactive HTML dashboard, and 23 automated tests.

projects.name: NearShare
projects.description: Ultra-Fast, Secure Local & Remote P2P File Sharing with E2E Encryption and ML-Driven Transfer Optimization
highlights: Engineered local & remote P2P file sharing with zero-cloud storage, securing chunk streams via ECDH (prime256v1) ephemeral key negotiation, AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption, and SHA-256 integrity digests.

Implemented an embedded k-NN telemetry model learning from session metrics (payload size, peer count) to dynamically optimize chunk sizing (256KB–2MB) and bypass redundant compression on media formats.

projects.name: StructDB
projects.description: Custom Relational Database Engine Built from Scratch
highlights: Implemented custom DBMS from scratch featuring SQL parser, B-Tree indexing for O(log n) lookups, ACID transactions with rollback, SHA-256 hashed storage, and a Tkinter GUI for visual query execution.
